nodes.name: Webhook (WAVV Note)
nodes.notes: GHL fires this when a WAVV disposition note is added. Payload carries contact_id + the note text under customData.note.

nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.notes: Get contact_id + the raw note text (customData.note).

nodes.name: Parse Disposition + Note
nodes.notes: WAVV-flagged notes only. Skips missed calls (disposition contains 'No Answer'/'Canceled' -> is_missed). Parses Disposition (kept only if in KNOWN, else '') and Note (empty if absent or 'Auto-disposition'). should_update = is_wavv AND not missed.

nodes.name: IF: update fields?
nodes.notes: TRUE only for a real WAVV disposition that isn't a missed call -> write the fields. FALSE (non-WAVV note OR a 'No Answer'/'Canceled' missed call) -> skip, so unrelated/missed-call notes never clear the fields.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ customFields: [ { id: 'YxGIrvPl5tfLeYoc7Ldr', value: $('Parse Disposition + Note').item.json.disposition }, { id: 'kVU8T6Swsh9sF4TWC81U', value: $('Parse Disposition + Note').item.json.note } ] }) }}

nodes.name: GHL: Set Call Fields

httpMultipleHeadersAuth.name: GHL [ Waterline Growth subaccount ] Multiple Headers Auth account

nodes.notes: Writes Call Disposition + Call Notes (even if empty). The field change triggers the Dispatcher (Automation 2).

nodes.name: GHL: Get Contact (tags)

httpMultipleHeadersAuth.name: GHL [ Waterline Growth subaccount ] Multiple Headers Auth account

nodes.notes: Reads the contact's current tags so we can find any starting with 'wavv-'.

nodes.name: Filter wavv- Tags
nodes.notes: Keeps only tags starting with 'wavv-' (case-insensitive). has_wavv_tags drives the delete.

nodes.name: GHL: Remove wavv- Tags

httpMultipleHeadersAuth.name: GHL [ Waterline Growth subaccount ] Multiple Headers Auth account

nodes.notes: DELETE /contacts/{id}/tags with the collected wavv- tags -> removes the auto-added wavv-<disposition> tag(s).

nodes.name: Gate: WAVV note?
nodes.notes: Passes only WAVV notes (any, incl. No Answer/Canceled missed calls) on to tag cleanup; other notes drop here.

nodes.name: Gate: has wavv- tags?
nodes.notes: Passes only when the contact actually has wavv- tags, so the DELETE never fires on an empty set.
